name: dubsync-backend
description: Backend for DubSync — YouTube Hindi Dubbing Chrome Extension

scripts.clean: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { ['audio-cache','temp'].forEach(d => fs.rmSync(d, {recursive:true,force:true}) && fs.mkdirSync(d, {recursive:true})); console.log('Cleaned audio-cache/ and temp/'); })"
